background: Commonwealth Bank of Australia is the largest of Australia's big four banks and the country's largest mortgage lender, funded mainly by Australian retail deposits, with a New Zealand subsidiary in ASB.
synthesis: All three agencies rate the bank, AA on average and the weakest of them at AA-, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 5 Mar 2026. Capital is middling against Australian peers, CET1 of 12.0% at the median and leverage of 4.6% a little below it. Liquidity is the firmer side, with NSFR of 115% in the top quarter even though LCR of 132% sits just under the median. Nothing has moved materially over the past four periods, on figures to 30 Jun 2026, and the single item flagged in the last 90 days, on 24 Sep 2026, concerns job cuts rather than credit.
